owner_calls.question: Marvel Database files the film versions under 'B' designations (Earth-65B, Earth-138B, Earth-50101B, Earth-1610B, Earth-928B for the Spider-Verse films; Earth-688B for Sony's Venom/Morbius/Madame Web films). The app uses the on-screen numbers (Earth-65, Earth-1610...) and Earth-688. Which should the app use?
options: Keep the on-screen numbers / Earth-688 as now
Switch to Marvel Database's B designations
owner_calls.evidence: For example, Gwendolyn Stacy (Earth-65B), Hobart Brown (Earth-138B), Gayatri Singh (Earth-50101B), Inspector Singh (Earth-50101B), Jefferson Morales (Earth-1610B), Mary Jane Watson (Earth-1610B), LYLA (Earth-928B), Julia Cornwall, Martin Moon and Martine Bancroft (Earth-688B). Margo Kess (Earth-22191), Jessica Drew (Earth-332) and Mary Jane Watson (Earth-616B) carry no extra suffix, so they match already. The films themselves name Earth-65, Earth-1610 and so on, so this is a question of which convention to follow.
